issues.reason: "consider" is non-factive, so flattening "is usually considered to be subjective" into (Inheritance mental_world subjective) asserts as fact what the text only reports as an opinion — the same over-assertion the attitudes section forbids ("A flat (Member sk_bridge_1 unsafe) here would wrongly assert the bridge really is unsafe") and that Core patterns' assert-only-what-the-text-states test rules out.

Same over-assertion with the polarity flipped: (Inheritance mental_world objective) at strength 0.0 states outright that the mental world is not objective, whereas the text only reports that it is usually considered not to be.

gaps_confirmed: impersonal / agentless reported attitude with a non-finite small-clause complement ("X is considered / regarded / thought TO BE P"): Propositional attitudes is restricted to a finite that-clause and wants an Experiencer holder, Perception reports needs an eventive complement, and the epistemic route is stated only for seem / appear

adverb of quantification over a state ("usually"): not a Manner adverb, and Every / TimesPer / QuantifierPhrase all key on countable occasions or a determiner, so there is no form for how generally a reported property is held to hold
new_gaps: a sealed proposition cannot carry a negation: polarity is encoded by the enclosing statement's strength and a nested term has no STV slot, so "considered to be NOT objective" has no representable form (denying the whole attitude bundle would instead say it is not considered objective, a different claim)
the STV of an attitude event whose complement is hedged ("usually considered") is unspecified — the confidence dial is documented for generalizations, not for attribution or reporting strength
repair_summary: Replaced the flat (Inheritance mental_world subjective) with the reported attitude that licenses it: a generic, agentless (passive, so no subject role atom) consider event whose Theme seals the proposition, per Core patterns' sealing; dropped (Inheritance mental_world objective) at strength 0.0 entirely, since the negated conjunct cannot be sealed and no licensed form records it — gap recorded rather than invented; kept both mental_world decomposition atoms untouched.
notes: The compound decomposition and the kind reading of "the mental world" were not challenged and are left as the parser wrote them. The repair loses the "and not objective" conjunct outright, which is the honest cost of having no negation-inside-a-seal form.
